नद् न॑दति (न॑द˚ते) sound, roar, cry, hum (±स्वनम्,
शब्दम्, etc.). C. नद॑यति or नादयति, ˚ते, pp. नादित (q.v.)
make resound. I. ना॑नदति (3. pl.) sound violently, howl, neigh.
—अनु & अभि sound towards (acc.);
 C. (also व्यनु) make resound, fill
with noise. उद् & समुद् sound, howl. roar, cry. उप C. make
resound. नि sound, cry out, shriek;
 C. = prec. C. प्र (णदति)
begin to cry or roar. प्रति sound back, answer with a cry or howl.
वि sound, cry, roar (±रवम्, स्वनम्, etc.), also = C. make resound,
fill
[]
with noise. सम् sound, roar, cry out. C. = prec. C., abs.
cry aloud.

नाद॑ m. loud sound, cry, roaring, thunder, sound or noise
i.g.
नदथु m. sounding, roaring.

नदनदीपति m. the lord of the rivers (conc. as
males & females), i.e. the ocean.
नदनदीभर्तृ m. the same.
नदनिम॑न् a. sounding, humming.
नदनु॑ m. noise, sound.
नदनुम॑न्त् a. sounding, thundering.
नदभर्तृ m. the ocean (lord of the streams).
नदराज m. the same.
नदि॑ m. crier, caller.
नदी v. नद॑.
नादि a. sounding, noisy.
नदीतट m. ˚तीर n. the bank of a river.
नदीन m. the ocean (also personif.).

नदीनद m. pl. & n. sgl. the rivers (conceived as males
& females).
नदीनाथ m. = नदराज.
नदीपति॑ m. = नदराज.
नदीपूर m. the flood of a river.
नदीमुख n. the mouth of a river.
नदीश m. = नदराज.
नदीसंतार m. the crossing of a river.
नदृश्य a. invisible.
नद्धि f. tying, binding.
नादित n. sound, roar, noise.

नादिन् a. sounding, roaring, thundering, resonant (often
—˚).
नादेय॑ a. belonging to or coming from a river, fluvial.
नाद्य॑ a. belonging to or coming from a river, fluvial.
